positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Benefits
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
● Nayya is an employee benefits platform that provides healthcare decision support and benefits navigation
● Build greenfield application that enables automated submission of insured’s supplementary health claims using NestJS, PostgreSQL and AWS resources (EventBridge, Lambda)
● Configure continuous integration and deployment of services using Terraform and GitHub Actions
● Spearhead effort to leverage json rules for representing complex policy exclusions and limitations
● Lead refactoring initiative to enhance scalability of benefit configuration, eligibility, and enrollment

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Admin
positions.description:
● Redesigned internal benefits admin tool to better support customer support team using React and Ruby on Rails
● Implemented feature flag settings for Nayya product packages using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL
● Enabled flexible configuration of employers’ critical illness and voluntary life insurance plans using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL
● Upheld domain driven design and command query responsibility segregation principles in backend services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
● Convene offers premium physical and virtual spaces to work, meet, and host inspiring events
● Architected greenfield solution to provide recording functionality within proprietary video conferencing tool using React, Node.js and AWS resources (Chime, ECS, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB)
● Led greenfield project to build closed captioning for event live-streams using React, Node.js and AWS Elemental
● Automated meeting room billing in workplace spaces using Node.js
● Developed self-service reports using Node.js and PostgreSQL that quantify virtual event attendee engagement
● Created flexible registration flow for virtual events using React and WordPress
● Mentored junior engineer on fundamental backend programming concepts

positions.title: Software Engineer, Concordance
positions.description:
● Concordance is a client-facing web application that reconciles third-party identifiers to FactSet identifiers so that data from different sources can be used in conjunction with FactSet’s data sets
● Built greenfield application using Vue.js and Python for users to manage data mappings and view update history
● Served as mentor for onboarding junior engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer, Cornerstone (CS)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
● CS is a client-facing workflow management and scheduling application that lets users set up workflows for client processes that upload, download, and transform data
● Designed proprietary health metric system using C# and Windows service that alerts on-call engineer if CS application is in an unstable state
● Maintained and enhanced job scheduling infrastructure using C# and AngularJS
